title: pteris quadriaurita var. subindivisa
intro: Pteris quadriaurita var. subindivisa, commonly known as Indian fern, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help in treating wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pteris quadriaurita var. subindivisa include anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer activities, which can help in protecting against cell damage, reducing inflammation, and preventing the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
